physicalNotes: Radius 0.17655486 Jupiter radii from Bonfanti et al. 2025 (2025A&A...693A..90B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..90B/abstract): 12,622.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Bonfanti et al. 2025 (2025A&A...693A..90B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A..90B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01195614 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
